verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies this capability. Perplexity Labs is pitched as bringing "reports and projects to life", Computer can write and execute code in a Linux sandbox that could produce files, and Thread Follow-Ups allow continued iteration in a conversation. Nothing explicitly documents creating presentations or documents, editing them iteratively, or exporting them, and one hands-on report says Computer sessions often fail to trigger or stall. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of document/presentation/spreadsheet generation, in-place iterative editing of created files, export formats/download, and independent corroboration that file creation works reliably.
